about.text: Queso blanco is a fresh white cheese of Latin America and the Caribbean, made by curdling hot milk with acid (or sometimes rennet) and lightly pressing the curd. It is soft, mild and does not melt.

facts.v: The common white cheese of Venezuelan cuisine, with regional kinds named for the region (llanero, paisa, palmita, guayanés)
Firm and used for frying in Puerto Rican cuisine, typically served with guava paste
